exceptions.reachability: The vulnerable esbuild path requires Deno's npm-module integration; Intentive invokes this dev-only Vite transitive only under Node.

The compatible 5.x dependency path is pinned to patched brace-expansion 5.0.8. Remaining 1.x and 2.x paths are reachable only through React Native's Jest, Babel coverage, and test-exclude tooling and are not loaded by the shipped Mobile Client; forcing those CommonJS consumers to 5.x would break their callable export contract.
